title: Xianxia Fantasy Storyboard
subtitle: 25-panel epic Chinese-fantasy keyframe and storyboard plan

panels.label: Immortal realm
panels.caption: Establish the scale and mythic world.
panels.prompt: wide establishing shot of a Chinese fantasy immortal realm, cloud sea, mountains, palace silhouettes, epic scale

panels.label: Mountain gate
panels.caption: Let the camera enter the realm.
panels.prompt: camera glides past a colossal mountain gate, rolling mist, glowing palace in the distance

panels.label: Hero silhouette
panels.caption: Use a small figure against the huge world.
panels.prompt: same xianxia protagonist from behind on stone steps, robe moving in wind, vast temple space

panels.label: Palace low angle
panels.caption: Turn architecture into spectacle.
panels.prompt: low-angle view of ornate Chinese fantasy palace eaves, carved beams, golden god rays through mist

panels.label: Sacred tree light
panels.caption: Introduce the main wonder symbol.
panels.prompt: towering sacred tree canopy, blossoms and spirit fish floating, volumetric light shafts

panels.label: Spirit creatures
panels.caption: Make the world feel alive.
panels.prompt: spirit fish, birds, or small mythical beasts crossing the foreground, same protagonist costume

panels.label: Ascending steps
panels.caption: Give the protagonist a clear direction.
panels.prompt: protagonist climbs broad stone stairs, robe and hair ribbon in wind, slow push-in

panels.label: Incense sigils
panels.caption: Use detail to prove the fantasy texture.
panels.prompt: bronze incense burner, carved talisman marks, gold dust macro detail, ancient mystery

panels.label: Sleeve and wind
panels.caption: Let costume and wind carry motion.
panels.prompt: medium close shot, protagonist raises one hand, sleeve crossing a light beam, elegant fabric motion

panels.label: Lit profile
panels.caption: Give the character emotion and identity.
panels.prompt: side portrait, protagonist looking toward the temple, face lit by a break in the clouds

panels.label: Suspended bridge
panels.caption: Expand the travel space.
panels.prompt: wide shot, suspended stone bridge connects mountain cliffs and palace halls, tiny protagonist silhouette

panels.label: Formation wakes
panels.caption: Turn spectacle into an event.
panels.prompt: glowing spell formation activates on the floor, runes spreading along stone steps, protagonist at center

panels.label: Water mirror
panels.caption: Add depth with reflection.
panels.prompt: water-mirror reflection of palace and protagonist, doubled image, soft moving mist

panels.label: Magic prop glows
panels.caption: Clarify power or mission.
panels.prompt: sword, jade tablet, or magic prop lights up in the protagonist's hand, teal-gold energy

panels.label: Gathered disciples
panels.caption: Make the world feel socially large.
panels.prompt: courtyard crowd facing the temple, disciples and robed figures arranged in foreground, midground, background

panels.label: Temple doors
panels.caption: Create the threshold before the climax.
panels.prompt: colossal temple doors opening slowly, white-gold light spilling out, protagonist before the entrance

panels.label: Clouds part
panels.caption: Let the sky answer the story beat.
panels.prompt: clouds split open above the palace, vertical god rays, mountains and halls revealed at larger scale

panels.label: Realm overhead
panels.caption: Reward the audience with a god view.
panels.prompt: aerial view of immortal city, mountains, waterfalls, and cloud sea, protagonist route remains readable

panels.label: Emotional close
panels.caption: Keep the human story inside the spectacle.
panels.prompt: close portrait, protagonist determined or awed, same immortal realm blurred behind

panels.label: Sword ascent
panels.caption: Begin the motion climax.
panels.prompt: protagonist rises on sword or light path, robe spreads, camera tilts upward following motion

panels.label: Sky river
panels.caption: Give one flowing large-scale wonder.
panels.prompt: celestial waterfall falling from clouds, mist and light particles around the protagonist's path

panels.label: Scale pressure
panels.caption: Make fate feel larger than the hero.
panels.prompt: extreme wide angle, sacred tree, palace, and mountains in one frame, protagonist tiny but clear

panels.label: Hero wide
panels.caption: The strongest hero frame of the board.
panels.prompt: xianxia hero wide shot, protagonist standing in divine light, full palace realm revealed

panels.label: Still look back
panels.caption: Resolve the climax into emotion.
panels.prompt: protagonist looks back toward camera, blossoms and glowing particles falling slowly, motion settling

panels.label: End-frame hold
panels.caption: A stable end frame or next-shot opener.
panels.prompt: stable end-frame composition, distant palace and protagonist silhouette, suitable image-to-video final frame
